cases.title: Quicktime Movie Playback Success
cases.description: Verify that standard .mov files play properly with valid codecs and container versions.

cases.title: Quicktime Movie Error Handling
cases.description: Verify the handling of corrupted files, unsupported codecs, or missing plugins when attempting to play Quicktime movies.

cases.title: Audio Formats Playback Success
cases.description: Verify that files in various supported sound formats (e.g., MP3, WAV, OGG, AAC) play successfully with correct controls.

cases.title: Unsupported Audio Formats Handling
cases.description: Verify that corrupted audio streams and unsupported sound formats are handled gracefully.

cases.title: Shockwave Movie Playback Success
cases.description: Verify that standard .dcr Shockwave movies play successfully utilizing supported plugin capabilities.

cases.title: Shockwave Runtime and File Errors
cases.description: Verify behavior when the Shockwave runtime is missing or when a corrupted Shockwave movie file is loaded.

opinions.feedback: The proposed high-level test cases effectively cover distinct scenarios for Quicktime, audio formats, and Shockwave playback, addressing both success paths and error handling without any blockers.
All test cases are well-structured, clear, and directly address the requirements provided. No blockers found.

analysis.analysis: R-132: Testable behavior: Play valid Quicktime movies. Boundaries: Supported Quicktime codecs and container versions. Normal paths: Successful playback of standard .mov files. Abnormal paths: Corrupted files, unsupported codecs, missing plugins. Ambiguities: 'Properly' lacks specific performance or visual quality metrics. R-133: Testable behavior: Play files in various sound formats. Boundaries: Supported audio codecs (e.g., MP3, WAV, OGG, AAC). Normal paths: Successful audio playback with correct controls. Abnormal paths: Corrupted audio streams, unsupported formats. Ambiguities: 'Various' is imprecise and lacks a definitive list of supported formats. R-134: Testable behavior: Play Shockwave movies. Boundaries: Supported Adobe Shockwave versions and browser plugin capabilities. Normal paths: Successful playback of .dcr files. Abnormal paths: Missing Shockwave runtime, corrupted movie files. Ambiguities: 'Played' does not specify interactive capability or performance benchmarks.
